candidateOccurrences.sourceText: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.
